_comment: ADR 0060 decision 5. Baseline = the gzip size of every <script src> of an empty Next route, measured at Stage 0. Allowance = what a public page may add. Change these only with the owner's approval.

routeJs._comment: Job CF: the gzip JavaScript every page route loads on a first visit (scripts/audit-route-js.mjs, from the build alone; `npm run audit:route-js`, run by CI after the build). Measured 12 Oct 2026 in a production build: the public pages 146 to 150 KB (React and the Next.js client are about 112 KB of it), the signed-in pages 172 to 197 KB. Each number is the measured size plus about 2%: a route that grows past it fails. `routes` names the pages people open most and the few that are larger than the rest; `public` and `app` are the ceilings of every other page. Job CJ: the Office is a plain plush room (no three.js: its 3D chunk and its own office3d ceiling are gone), and Agent OWL and the Office owls (the plush owlets, jobs CI and CJ) are in the page itself; their pictures are lazy files, not script. Measured 13 Oct 2026 after job CJ: Today 200,190, the Office 182,479, the landing page 152,718 (margin 282). Raise a number only with a reason in the commit; the owner approves a raised ceiling. Owner decision 14 Oct 2026 (job CL, after CK): Today 201,000 -> 204,000 and the landing page 153,000 -> 156,000, headroom for waves 2 and 3 while the pack-aware frame (menu words, module gate, core tab) landed; a later trim job takes the weight out again. Job CO (night run C2, 15 Oct 2026): the four new building-materials product routes (/materials, /materials/new, /materials/[itemId], /materials/[itemId]/edit) carry the product editor (photos, extra details) and measure 187,805 B, about 1.8 KB over the signed-in default; they are new routes of a new feature, not a raise of an existing ceiling, and the saree catalogue routes stay under their own (the materials screens are on their own routes so that a saree workspace never downloads them). Each is set to 190,000. A trim job can share the photo code of the two editors. Job CQ (night run C2, 15 Oct 2026): the five new campaign routes (/campaigns, /campaigns/new, /campaigns/[campaignId], /campaigns/[campaignId]/edit, /call-list) share one client chunk set of 187,196 B (the form, the people list with its list reader, the approval sheet, the results and the call list); job CS adds the school's audience (students' parents) and the two announcement routes (/announcements, /announcements/new) on the same set, now 187,920 B, about 1.2 KB over the signed-in default; they are new routes of a new feature, not a raise of an existing ceiling. Each is set to 190,000. Owner decision 31 Oct 2026 (code-split job): the notification panel, the install hint and the error screens are chunks of their own (loaded when needed, not with every page); measured after: Today 197,367 (was 203,668), /catalogue 171,532 (was 177,999), the Office 173,933 (was 180,441), settings 177,600 (was 184,070), outbox 177,786 (was 183,938), materials and campaigns 181,044 and 180,844 (were 187,595 and 187,395), the landing page 147,334 (was 150,496). Ceilings are measured + 5 %, never above the old ceiling: only settings (193,000 -> 187,000), the Office (184,000 -> 183,000) and the landing page (156,000 -> 155,000) came down; the others were already below measured + 5 %, so they keep their numbers and now have about 3 to 5 % of headroom.
